breaking_news.headline: FIFA's World Cup ticket sales outraged fans. Now they are under investigation
breaking_news.summary: FIFA has always had a peculiar way to sell tickets to the World Cup. It never faced any major issues — until prices soared for the 2026 tournament.

breaking_news.headline: CBS' Bari Weiss overhauls '60 Minutes,' fires top producer and reporters
breaking_news.summary: The new head of CBS News is flexing her muscles at the network's most storied news program: "60 Minutes." We look at the upheaval.

breaking_news.headline: Here's how we're coping with high gas prices, according to Costco and Walmart
breaking_news.summary: Sky-high gas prices have drivers going out of their way for discounts at the pump. Oil executives warn that even higher prices might be on the horizon.

breaking_news.headline: United Airlines flight to Spain pulls U-turn, apparently over Bluetooth device name
breaking_news.summary: The flight to Palma de Mallorca diverted back to Newark late on Saturday. Air traffic audio and social media posts indicate an onboard Bluetooth device raised security concerns.

breaking_news.headline: One by one, U.S. civil rights agency dismantles tools to fight discrimination
breaking_news.summary: The EEOC is seeking to overturn rules created decades ago to tackle discrimination in employment. The Trump administration says those rules have led to more discrimination —against white people.

breaking_news.headline: Remote work -- not AI -- has sidelined recent college graduates, research finds
breaking_news.summary: Research from the New York Fed finds that younger college graduates have been sidelined by remote work in recent years, as companies may be reluctant to hire those needing more training and mentoring.

breaking_news.headline: AI giant Anthropic prepares to sell stock to the public; files preliminary IPO paperwork
breaking_news.summary: The Anthropic IPO, and those of other AI-related firms like OpenAI, could be among the biggest in U.S. history.

breaking_news.headline: DOJ is investigating former congressman George Santos for insider trading on Kalshi
breaking_news.summary: The disgraced former congressman allegedly bet on whether he would appear at the State of the Union address, prompting federal investigations.

breaking_news.headline: Mysteriously missing congressman wins primary after Trump endorsement
breaking_news.summary: Republican lawmaker Tom Kean Jr has not been seen in Washington or his New Jersey district for several months.

breaking_news.headline: Mayor cancels DR Congo friendly with Chile in Spain over Ebola concern
breaking_news.summary: DR Congo's international friendly against Chile in Spain next week is cancelled after authorities raise health concerns over the Ebola outbreak in the African nation.

breaking_news.headline: British couple lose Iran jail sentence appeal, family says
breaking_news.summary: Lindsay and Craig Foreman were arrested in January 2025 during a global motorbike journey.

breaking_news.headline: 'They'll fix the building, but not our souls': Sleepy Kyiv neighbourhood hit in Russian strike
breaking_news.summary: Scenes of devastation greet residents emerging from underground shelters after a major Russian attack.

breaking_news.headline: Putin remains uncompromising on Ukraine, but is public discourse on war changing in Russia?
breaking_news.summary: Russia is intensifying attacks in Ukraine but more than four years of war are causing concern even among Putin loyalists.

breaking_news.headline: US and Iran launch new strikes as ceasefire negotiations stalled
breaking_news.summary: US launches fresh strikes on Iran and an oil tanker as Tehran says it attacked US bases in the Gulf.

breaking_news.headline: Israel strikes southern Lebanon but partial truce with Hezbollah appears to hold
breaking_news.summary: Israel continues its campaign in the south, though has not struck Beirut after a deal announced by the US.

breaking_news.headline: Microsoft says new quantum chip 1,000 times more reliable than predecessor
breaking_news.summary: The tech giant predicts it will have a quantum computer that can solve commercially useful problems by the end of the decade.

breaking_news.headline: Instagram AI chatbot tricked by hackers to give access to others' accounts
breaking_news.summary: Some reports have linked the incident to recent cases of high-profile Instagram accounts being hijacked.

breaking_news.headline: How 'confused' AI rollout hurts firms and baffles staff
breaking_news.summary: Some firms are putting pressure on staff to use AI, but have not thought through their AI rollout.

breaking_news.headline: Water firm fined £1.8m over parasite outbreak
breaking_news.summary: Four people were hospitalised and there were more than 140 cases of sickness and diarrhoea in Devon.

breaking_news.headline: Microsoft testing wearable AI gadget aimed at office workers
breaking_news.summary: The company said its own workers are testing a "wearable access badge" and a desktop device.
